limitations: AGB is a stand-level BTC model output at the managed AU site index, not a plot measurement.
Biomass_Live_Above excludes roots; do not add Roots when comparing to harvest slash.
The biomass run did not include the grade or volume banks; volume is taken from managed_au_curves.csv.

provenance.agb_definition: Biomass_Live_Above = stem wood + bark + foliage + branch; roots and total are reported separately.

transformations.additivity_checks: Above == wood+bark+foliar+branch and Total == Above+roots; the compile fails loudly if either identity breaks.
transformations.age_grid: 0-350 by 10 years, matching the compiled grade/residue table.
transformations.wide_to_long: One row per managed AU and BTC age column; Biomass_Live_Above is used as AGB. No interpolation, rescaling, or allometric synthesis.
